# AnimateDiff SD 1.5 v2 motion adapter

AnimateDiff authors · released 2023-09

Motion adapter requiring a compatible Stable Diffusion 1.5 base; no score borrowed from a complete AnimateDiff pipeline.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/guoyww/animatediff-motion-adapter-v1-5-2)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/guoyww/animatediff-motion-adapter-v1-5-2/blob/6167b88ffe39b4441fdf2113e77b99a6f56b7906/README.md)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

### Run it on your own machine

**Other engines**

```sh
# fp32 motion module + SD 1.5 (sd.cpp) · ~7.8GB
sd-cli -M vid_gen --model models/v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors --motion-module models/mm_sd_v15_v2.ckpt --offload-to-cpu --diffusion-fa -p "a red apple on a wooden table" --cfg-scale 8.0 --sampling-method euler --scheduler discrete -H 384 -W 384 --video-frames 16 --fps 8 --steps 20 -s 42 -o out.avi
```
